evidence: Tagged with the 'Private Broadcast' label and alters network transaction relay behavior to route unconfirmed wallet rebroadcasts through the private broadcast mechanism.
rationale: Fixes a privacy leak where periodic rebroadcasts bypass private broadcast and broadcast to all peers. When '-privatebroadcast=1' is enabled, unconfirmed transactions broadcast periodically every 12 to 36 hours currently use the standard send-to-all broadcast, compromising transaction origin privacy.
